name: Read-Write Paths Checking
description: Checks for the presence of critical system paths that are writable, which can indicate a compromised environment.

evidenceUnits.title: Critical system path writability
evidenceUnits.proposition: The app-local permission probe reports a critical path as writable
evidenceUnits.availability: Depends on path visibility and the semantics of the tested access operation
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The result is scoped to the app mount namespace, credentials, and mediated VFS view
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Writability can have legitimate causes and does not identify a modification mechanism
